translation_direction: bn → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Bengali electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Ratan uses cậu/con; the postmaster uses tôi/em; narration calls him ông trưởng trạm and her nó/con bé.
decisions.rationale: Keeps the household hierarchy fixed so that his tôi/em reads as detached kindness rather than romance; tao/mày would be harsher than তুই.

decisions.decision: Speaker labels in passages 1.6–1.8 and 1.19–1.22 are rendered “Ông trưởng trạm:” / “Ratan:”, and questions take ? although Bengali often ends them with ।.
decisions.rationale: Keeps the source’s abrupt dramatic form while following Vietnamese punctuation.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: quê mùa tầm thường sounded contemptuous for সামান্য গ্রাম্য বালিকা at the tenderest moment; now cô bé thôn quê nhỏ nhoi.
Restored ভাসিয়া (floating in tears), pairing Ratan with the floating traveller of 1.32: Nó chỉ trôi giữa dòng nước mắt.
The honorific verb gives the postmaster himself credit for passing the conjuncts; the subject ông is restored.
ছলছল and ধরণী now rưng rưng … mặt đất; the lap image of জগতের ক্রোড়বিচ্যুত restored; idiomatic ai là gì của ai.
The ভ্রান্তিপাশ noose echo restored as thòng lọng.
The court-petition image (নালিশ … দরবারে) and the defeated monsoon’s remnant clouds restored.
অন্তর্যামী জানেন now có Trời chứng giám; genie and mansions instead of demon and high-rises.
Ratan names his family ‘mẹ’, ‘chị’, ‘anh’ as her own; হৃদয়পটে restored as khung tranh.
Ratan’s timid question no longer presumes (nhé removed); রুটি গড়া is cán bánh.
Removed the ambiguous vì tôi đi đâu in the postmaster’s reassurance.
The new postmaster receives no honorific (Viên trưởng trạm mới), as in the source.
Changed Ông trưởng trạm bưu điện to the neutral Người trưởng trạm bưu điện, closer to the bare job title for a young Calcutta man.
ভদ্রলোক kept as a class word (con nhà gia giáo); also fixed 1.7, 1.9, 1.15, 1.28 and 1.31 wording.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: The affectionate form a household servant uses for a young master; Ratan calls herself con. The shift from babu to dadababu is not separately marked.

glossary.source_term: আটচালা / কলিকা / খোল-করতাল / বাউল / খাটিয়া / রুটি
glossary.draft_rendering: nhà tranh tám mái / nõ điếu / trống khol, chũm chọe kartal / hát rong Baul / giường dây / bánh roti
glossary.rationale: Concrete Bengal village items kept recognisable, with transliteration only where Vietnamese has no equivalent.

glossary.draft_rendering: người lữ khách trôi trên dòng nước / trôi giữa dòng nước mắt
glossary.rationale: Tagore pairs the departing traveller floating on the river with Ratan floating in tears; both use trôi.

witness_decision: Selected the validated (proofread level 4) Bengali Wikisource transcription of গল্পগুচ্ছ, vol. 1 (Visva-Bharati; new edition 1353 Bhadra / 1946, the scanned copy reprinted 1357 Chaitra), scan pages 32–38. First publication: Hitabadi, 1298 B.S. (1891). The editors’ conjectural periodical date printed after the story is apparatus and is excluded; the witness spelling থাটিয়ায় (passage 1.17, for খাটিয়ায়) is retained as printed.

unresolved_questions.explanation: ‘স্বরে অ’ ‘স্বরে আ’ is domesticated as Vietnamese ê a ‘a’, ‘ă’; the Bengali vowel names are not preserved.
Both বাবু and দাদাবাবু become cậu, so Ratan’s growing intimacy is carried by context rather than a change of address.

title_review.rationale: পোস্ট্‌মাস্টার is a bare job title for a young man; Người trưởng trạm bưu điện names his actual sub-post-office post neutrally, matches the body term ông trưởng trạm without the honorific weight of Ông in the title, and keeps the narrator’s ironic distance.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Compared the posting, the village, the poems, Ratan’s introduction, evening calls, the play-script exchange, memories and family talk.
Compared the monsoon noon, the reading lessons, the rains, the illness, nursing, the transfer request and the waiting.
Compared the parting dialogue, the refused request, the bath water, the money, the river, the traveller’s philosophy and the closing apostrophe.
